name: move_enable
description: enable PS Move wand input (restart required)

name: move_blue_orb
description: Blue orb while Move is in use; uses a trackable blue hue with PS Eye

name: move_sensitivity
description: view degrees per degree of Move rotation

name: move_freeaim_turn_button
description: independent aim turn button: 0 mapped clutch, 1 T, 2 X, 3 Square, 4 Circle, 5 Triangle, 6 Start, 7 Select, 8 Move

name: move_freeaim_invert
description: independent aim: release to turn, hold to lock camera and aim reticle

name: move_freeaim_turn_gain
description: independent camera turn multiplier, 0.5 to 12; fine aim is unchanged

name: move_deadzone
description: Move gyro drift deadzone in radians/sec

name: move_invert_y
description: invert Move pitch

name: move_nav
description: use Navigation button layout with a connected Move

name: move_nav_port
description: Navigation pad port, 0 automatic or 1-7

name: move_gestures
description: enable optional Move gestures in gameplay

name: move_gesture_shake
description: shake action: 0 off, 1 reload, 2 next weapon, 3 use, 4 jump

name: move_gesture_flick
description: enable left/right flick turns

name: move_gesture_angle
description: flick turn degrees

name: move_gesture_shake_limit
description: shake acceleration threshold in G

name: move_gesture_flick_limit
description: flick yaw threshold in radians per second

name: move_gesture_cooldown
description: seconds between gestures

name: move_camera
description: use PS Eye light-ball tracking

name: move_camera_sensitivity
description: light-ball cursor and look sensitivity

name: move_camera_mirror
description: mirror camera X for natural screen pointing

name: move_camera_fallback
description: use gyro if the light ball is not tracked

name: move_camera_edge_turn
description: continuous horizontal turning near optical aim edges

name: move_camera_edge_zone
description: central optical aim region, fraction of half-width

name: move_camera_turn_speed
description: maximum optical edge turn speed in degrees/sec

name: move_camera_steadiness
description: optical jitter filtering strength, 0 to 3

name: move_freeaim
description: independent Move reticle with configurable camera hold behavior

name: move_freeaim_range
description: maximum reticle distance from center, fraction of half-screen

name: r_stereo
description: Enable stereoscopic rendering (restart required)

name: r_stereo_mode
description: 1 side-by-side, 2 over/under, 3 HDMI frame-packed, 4 frame-sequential (restart required)

name: r_stereo_depth
description: Eye separation multiplier, 0 to 3

name: r_stereo_convergence
description: Zero parallax distance in world units

name: r_stereo_swap
description: Swap left and right eyes

name: move_bind_t
description: Move T: PS3 button mask (R2 fire)

name: move_bind_move
description: Move button: L1 grenade switch

name: move_bind_square
description: Square: reload/use

name: move_bind_cross
description: Cross: jump

name: move_bind_circle
description: Circle: melee

name: move_bind_triangle
description: Triangle: change weapon
